stem:
Anvi finds $35\%$ of $60$ mentally by splitting into benchmark percentages.

Which two claims correctly compute that value?

options.text: Call "same whole" the finished answer and stop, with no percent of $60$ computed.
Each benchmark piece is taken of the same whole $60$ before the pieces are added.
Use the same benchmark story to compare lengths on an unrelated map scale.

teacher.key_rationale: 35% of 60 is 30%+5% of the same whole: 18+3=21. Naming "same whole" alone or exporting the method to map scales miss the benchmark computation.
